blind_spots.blind_spot: Zero-download web products assume open-internet users; their actual customer (Space Systems Command / IC) lives on accredited networks where an uncertified SaaS cannot touch mission data
blind_spots.operator_reality: A guardian or analyst on NIPR/SIPR cannot 'just join' a commercial web meeting tool or web search app; without an ATO and IL-appropriate hosting, Shannon/RUTHI never reach the desk of the user the SBIR was written for
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team built a commercial productivity SaaS first and retrofitted a defense mission statement; no accreditation language appears anywhere in ~1,374 words of their own text
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Securely join or host meetings on Shannon hassle-free and with zero downloads.

blind_spots.blind_spot: OSINT-to-SDA pipeline ignores the cross-domain step: how open-source intelligence gets INTO classified Space Domain Awareness workflows is the transition, and it is unaddressed
blind_spots.operator_reality: SSC decision-making runs on classified systems; moving OSINT across the boundary requires cross-domain solutions and accreditation that routinely outlast a Phase II period of performance — the exact months-to-field > funded-months failure
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The abstract sells analytic value ('improving situational awareness, decision-making'), not an ingestion/accreditation architecture; nothing on their site suggests they have fielded on a government network
blind_spots.evidence_quote: utilizing Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) data for improving situational awareness, decision-making

blind_spots.blind_spot: No training or sustainment story from a team that shrank to roughly 2-4 people while holding a $1.24M Phase II
blind_spots.operator_reality: Even if RUTHI reaches SSC, someone must train users, patch, and support it on a government schedule; a 2-person company cannot staff sustainment, and no partner/prime relationship is mentioned anywhere
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Their values page centers empathy and general accessibility rather than a fielding plan; the defense customer is treated as one audience of a horizontal search product
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Imagine an 8-year-old using PATTIE to explore ways to combat climate change.

opener_hook: Cymantix's 2023 Space Force Phase II sells OSINT into Space Systems Command SDA, yet across cymantix.com there is no accreditation or classified-ingest path mentioned — the step that usually outlives a Phase II period of performance.
what_they_do: Tiny NC startup building web-based meeting-capture (Shannon) and visual data-exploration/search (RUTHI) tools, with an SBIR Phase II applying OSINT to Space Force space domain awareness.
